title: Merchant Under Attack
description: Ahead, a merchant's cart is stopped crossways in the road and figures are dragging crates into the ditch while the driver pleads.
teaches: protect a civilian target while dealing with mobile threats

choices.label: Charge in and drive the raiders off
Circle wide and cut off their escape with the loot
Call out — some of these are just desperate, not cruel

title: The Lost Child
description: A child sits at the roadside, too exhausted to cry, clutching a single shoe and pointing back the way you came.
teaches: consequences ripple — where did they come from, and what is following?

choices.label: Take the child to the nearest safe camp
Follow the child's trail to whatever they fled
Let Ragash's hounds find the family by scent

title: The Traveling Healer
description: A healer works a line of the sick under a lean-to, out of clean water and nearly out of hope.
teaches: small kindnesses seed reputation and future aid

choices.label: Share your own medicine and water
Have Maeve take over the worst cases
Wish them well and move on

title: Hidden Pack Scouts
description: Shapes pace you through the undergrowth, never closing, never leaving. Watching. Testing.
teaches: not every watcher is an enemy — reputation and Ronan change this

choices.label: Let Ronan step forward and be recognised
Leave fresh meat on a stump and keep walking
Form up and wait to see what they want

title: The Wandering Knight
description: A knight in dented, honest armour rests a spear across their knees and studies you without alarm.
teaches: allies of convenience — and Talos knows the type

choices.label: Let Talos take their measure, soldier to soldier
Ask what road they walk and whether it's yours
Nod and give them the peace they came for

title: Corrupted Wildlife
description: A stag steps into the path, and it is wrong — its eyes are wept-over black and it does not fear you at all.
teaches: corruption is a spreading enemy; Corwin can read its source

choices.label: End it cleanly — there is nothing left to save
Let Corwin study it before you strike
Break line of sight and slip past

title: The Refugee Caravan
description: A slow line of carts and walking wounded crawls toward you, everything they own lashed down and everyone they lost left behind.
teaches: world state made visible — the Frontier is emptying

choices.label: Point them to the safest camp you know
Walk them past the dangerous stretch of road
Ask what drove them out — and listen

title: The Traveling Storyteller
description: By a shared fire, a storyteller trades a night's tale for a night's bread, and the Frontier's rumours all pass through them eventually.
teaches: lore and rumour flow through the living world

choices.label: Stay for a tale — you may learn something true
Trade a story of your own for news of the road ahead
Let the party rest and simply enjoy it

title: The Abandoned Campsite
description: Cold ashes, a kettle still hung, bedrolls left where they lay. People left here in a hurry and did not come back for their things.
teaches: environmental storytelling before a word is spoken

choices.label: Read the site — what happened, and how long ago?
Take what's useful; the owners won't be needing it
Leave it as a marker and move on

title: The Injured Animal
description: A young wolf lies in a snare, leg torn, too spent to snap at you — only watching, the way a frightened thing watches.
teaches: mercy has a memory; Ragash and Ronan both react

choices.label: Free it gently and let it run
Have Maeve or Ragash tend the leg first
End its pain if the wound is past saving
